name: digo-email
description: Campaign statistics, draft campaigns, contacts, lists and tags of your DIGO Email account.

interface.longDescription:
DIGO Email is an email marketing service for small businesses and online shops. Connect your DIGO Email account to work on your newsletters in plain language:

- Check how a campaign performed: delivered, opened, clicked, unsubscribed and bounced, rates, most clicked links and the comparison with your previous campaigns.
- See who opened, clicked or did not open a campaign, and download the full list as a CSV file from your DIGO Email dashboard.
- Write and edit draft campaigns with the same blocks as the visual editor, send a test to yourself, schedule a campaign or stop a send, only when you ask.
- Search, add and edit contacts, move them between lists and assign tags, for example to everyone who did not open a campaign.

Everything follows the rules of your account, exactly as in the dashboard: verified sending domains, credits, consent history and automations. A campaign is sent or scheduled only after your explicit request, and ChatGPT asks you to confirm actions that change your data.

Requires a DIGO Email account. The plugin only accesses the account you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time from Integrations in your dashboard. It cannot delete contacts or campaigns, buy credits or change account settings.
defaultPrompt: How did my last email campaign perform?
Who didn't open my last campaign? Give me a CSV to download.
Draft a newsletter for my customers list about this month's news.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my DIGO Email account: credits, active contacts and latest campaigns.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo shop Bottega Lumi: active account, available credits, active contacts out of the limit, no verified sending domain, and the latest sent campaigns with their main results. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Statistics of a sent campaign, read only.
positive.prompt: How did the campaign "Collezione autunno: tazze e ciotole" perform?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports recipients, delivered emails, open and click rates, unsubscribes and bounces, clicks per link and the results of the previous campaigns for reference. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Recipients who did not open a campaign, with a CSV export link.
positive.prompt: Who didn't open "Corso di ceramica: nuove date"? Give me a link to download the list.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives how many recipients did not open, lists the first ones with name and email, and returns a CSV link on www.digo.email that downloads the full list once signed in to DIGO Email.

positive.description: Tag every contact who did not open a campaign (write action).
positive.prompt: Add the tag "Da riconquistare" to everyone who didn't open "Newsletter di settembre".
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, adds the tag (creating it if missing) to the contacts who received but did not open that campaign and reports how many contacts changed. The tag then appears in get_lists_tags_and_fields.

positive.description: Write a draft campaign for a list (write action, nothing is sent).
positive.prompt: Write a draft for the "Clienti negozio" list announcing new pottery classes in December, with a button to https://www.example.com/corsi.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft addressed to the "Clienti negozio" list with heading, text and button blocks, and reports the review checks and the link to open it in the editor. Nothing is sent: the demo account has no verified sending domain, so the checks say the draft cannot be sent yet.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported: the plugin has no delete tools, so ChatGPT should say it cannot delete contacts or campaigns and point to the DIGO Email dashboard.
negative.prompt: Delete all my contacts and campaigns.

negative.description: Purchases are not supported: the plugin does not sell or buy anything, so ChatGPT should say it cannot buy credits.
negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more email credits for my account.

negative.description: Contacts need consent: purchased addresses must not be added as subscribed, so ChatGPT should refuse or ask whether these people agreed to receive emails.
negative.prompt: Add these 300 email addresses I bought from a list broker to my newsletter as subscribed contacts.

review.commerce_description: DIGO Email does not sell products or take payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Campaign statistics and recipients with CSV export, draft campaigns with test sends, scheduling and stop, contacts, lists and tags. 1.0.1: tool names that say what each tool does, every tool hint set explicitly, and separate tools to add or remove contacts from lists and tags.

it-IT.subtitle: Campagne email e contatti
it-IT.description:
DIGO Email è il servizio di email marketing per piccole imprese e negozi online. Collega il tuo account DIGO Email e lavora alle newsletter scrivendo come parli:

- Guarda com'è andata una campagna: consegnate, aperte, clic, disiscrizioni e indirizzi non validi, percentuali, link più cliccati e confronto con le campagne precedenti.
- Scopri chi ha aperto, cliccato o non ha aperto una campagna e scarica l'elenco completo in CSV dal pannello di DIGO Email.
- Scrivi e modifica bozze con gli stessi blocchi dell'editor visuale, invia una prova a te stesso, programma una campagna o ferma un invio, solo quando lo chiedi.
- Cerca, aggiungi e modifica contatti, spostali tra liste e assegna tag, per esempio a chi non ha aperto una campagna.

Tutto segue le regole del tuo account, come nel pannello: domini di invio verificati, crediti, storico dei consensi e automazioni. Una campagna parte o viene programmata solo su tua richiesta esplicita, e ChatGPT ti chiede conferma prima delle azioni che modificano i dati.

Serve un account DIGO Email. Il plugin accede solo all'account che colleghi e puoi scollegarlo in qualsiasi momento da Integrazioni nel pannello. Non può eliminare contatti o campagne, acquistare crediti né cambiare le impostazioni dell'account.

es-ES.subtitle: Campañas de email y contactos
es-ES.description:
DIGO Email es el servicio de email marketing para pequeñas empresas y tiendas online. Conecta tu cuenta de DIGO Email y trabaja en tus newsletters con lenguaje natural:

- Consulta los resultados de una campaña: entregados, aperturas, clics, bajas y rebotes, porcentajes, enlaces más pulsados y comparación con tus campañas anteriores.
- Descubre quién abrió, hizo clic o no abrió una campaña y descarga la lista completa en CSV desde tu panel de DIGO Email.
- Escribe y modifica borradores con los mismos bloques del editor visual, envíate una prueba, programa una campaña o detén un envío, solo cuando lo pidas.
- Busca, añade y modifica contactos, muévelos entre listas y asigna etiquetas, por ejemplo a quienes no abrieron una campaña.

Todo sigue las reglas de tu cuenta, igual que en el panel: dominios de envío verificados, créditos, historial de consentimientos y automatizaciones. Una campaña solo se envía o se programa cuando lo pides expresamente, y ChatGPT te pide confirmación antes de las acciones que modifican tus datos.

Necesitas una cuenta de DIGO Email. El plugin solo accede a la cuenta que conectas y puedes desconectarlo cuando quieras desde Integraciones en el panel. No puede eliminar contactos ni campañas, comprar créditos ni cambiar los ajustes de la cuenta.

fr-FR.subtitle: Campagnes e-mail et contacts
fr-FR.description:
DIGO Email est le service d’e-mail marketing pour les petites entreprises et les boutiques en ligne. Connectez votre compte DIGO Email et travaillez sur vos newsletters en langage naturel :

- Consultez les résultats d’une campagne : e-mails délivrés, ouvertures, clics, désinscriptions et rebonds, taux, liens les plus cliqués et comparaison avec vos campagnes précédentes.
- Découvrez qui a ouvert, cliqué ou n’a pas ouvert une campagne, et téléchargez la liste complète en CSV depuis votre tableau de bord DIGO Email.
- Rédigez et modifiez des brouillons avec les mêmes blocs que l’éditeur visuel, envoyez-vous un test, programmez une campagne ou arrêtez un envoi, uniquement quand vous le demandez.
- Recherchez, ajoutez et modifiez des contacts, déplacez-les entre listes et attribuez des tags, par exemple à ceux qui n’ont pas ouvert une campagne.

Tout respecte les règles de votre compte, comme dans le tableau de bord : domaines d’envoi vérifiés, crédits, historique des consentements et automatisations. Une campagne n’est envoyée ou programmée que sur votre demande explicite, et ChatGPT vous demande confirmation avant les actions qui modifient vos données.

Un compte DIGO Email est nécessaire. Le plugin n’accède qu’au compte que vous connectez et vous pouvez le déconnecter à tout moment depuis Intégrations dans le tableau de bord. Il ne peut pas supprimer de contacts ni de campagnes, acheter des crédits ni modifier les paramètres du compte.

de-DE.subtitle: E-Mail-Kampagnen und Kontakte
de-DE.description:
DIGO Email ist der E-Mail-Marketing-Dienst für kleine Unternehmen und Onlineshops. Verbinde dein DIGO Email-Konto und arbeite an deinen Newslettern in natürlicher Sprache:

- Sieh dir an, wie eine Kampagne gelaufen ist: zugestellt, geöffnet, geklickt, abgemeldet und unzustellbar, Quoten, meistgeklickte Links und der Vergleich mit deinen früheren Kampagnen.
- Finde heraus, wer eine Kampagne geöffnet, geklickt oder nicht geöffnet hat, und lade die vollständige Liste als CSV aus deinem DIGO Email-Dashboard herunter.
- Schreibe und bearbeite Entwürfe mit denselben Blöcken wie im visuellen Editor, sende dir einen Test, plane eine Kampagne oder stoppe einen Versand, nur wenn du darum bittest.
- Suche, ergänze und bearbeite Kontakte, verschiebe sie zwischen Listen und vergib Tags, zum Beispiel an alle, die eine Kampagne nicht geöffnet haben.

Alles folgt den Regeln deines Kontos, genau wie im Dashboard: verifizierte Absenderdomains, Credits, Einwilligungsverlauf und Automationen. Eine Kampagne wird nur auf deine ausdrückliche Bitte versendet oder geplant, und ChatGPT bittet dich vor Aktionen, die deine Daten ändern, um Bestätigung.

Du brauchst ein DIGO Email-Konto. Das Plugin greift nur auf das Konto zu, das du verbindest, und du kannst es jederzeit unter Integrationen im Dashboard trennen. Es kann keine Kontakte oder Kampagnen löschen, keine Credits kaufen und keine Kontoeinstellungen ändern.
